WITH product_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as item_count
  FROM Products p
  LEFT JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
product_metrics_with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    avg_quantity,
    item_count,
    CAST(item_count AS REAL) / 15 as share
  FROM product_metrics
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_avg_quantity,
    AVG(CAST(item_count AS REAL)) as avg_item_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM product_metrics_with_share
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_avg_quantity) as final_avg_quantity,
  AVG(avg_item_count) as final_avg_item_count,
  AVG(avg_share) as final_avg_share
FROM type_averages
